title: 'Little appetite for regime change’: Trump offers 'help' for Iran's protesters, but what can he do?
summary: US President Donald Trump told Iranian protesters on Tuesday that “help is on its way” as he weighed options to punish Tehran for its brutal crackdown. As the threat of military action looms, analysts say Trump's inclination for one-off strikes means he is unlikely to push for the regime change craved by many protesters.
